operations.summary: List the module, pack and theme feature codes the local entitlement lease grants
operations.summary_zh: 列出本地授权租约授予的模块、规则包与主题功能码
operations.description: Any authenticated session. Modules is empty unless the verified local lease is valid (grace included is not valid), matching the API entry gate (entitlement_feature_denied) and the publication gate. Front-end menu items with requiredModule are shown only when the code is listed.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Local lease state (valid, grace, expired, revoked, invalid, uninstalled).

fields.name: modules
fields.description: The codes the control plane acts on: the lease's module codes, plus module.doh, module.rum and module.content_rewrite when a valid lease issued before those codes names none of them (the publication gate delivers them under the same rule).

fields.name: lease_modules
fields.description: The lease's literal module codes, empty under the same rule as modules.

fields.name: features
fields.description: The lease's other feature codes (e.g. packages.manage, which package publish requires), empty under the same rule as modules, so a page can tell a missing feature from an unusable lease before a gated write. The write gates are unchanged.

responses.description: Authentication failed or the session is invalid.
responses.description_zh: 认证失败或会话已失效。

responses.description: The request could not be completed because of an internal failure.
responses.description_zh: 服务内部故障，请求未完成。
